description.en: Step Plan credit and rolling-window quota carried by the provider plugin.
description.zh: 由 Provider 插件提供 Step Plan Credits 与滚动窗口配额。

description.en: Add the serving key and, optionally, a console cookie for quota refresh.
description.zh: 填写推理密钥，并可选补充用于刷新额度的控制台 Cookie。

help_text.en: Optional. Paste the full cookie block from the plan-usage page to refresh the Credits, 5-hour, and weekly quota.
help_text.zh: 可选。从 plan-usage 页面粘贴完整 Cookie，用于刷新 Credits、5 小时和每周额度。

title.zh: 连接阶跃星辰 Step Plan
